title: Some Simple Economics of Open versus Closed AI
headline_summary: Who funds AI when open weights are free?
blurb: A16z analyzes the core economic question plaguing AI: who funds and secures models when open weights are free? If trained model weights become commodities, funding responsibility and safety accountability become murky. This tension directly shapes venture allocation decisions between open-source infrastructure plays, proprietary AI companies hunting defensibility, and the capital-intensive foundation bets that increasingly demand premium valuations to survive competition.

title: Cerebras stock plunges 14% after second earnings report following IPO
headline_summary: Cerebras stock plunges 14% despite beating Q2 expectations
blurb: Cerebras Systems stock cratered 14% following its Q2 earnings report, the company's second since going public. The AI semiconductor chip maker delivered better-than-expected revenue and raised full-year guidance. Yet investors sold sharply, signaling deep concerns about profitability timelines for AI infrastructure companies.

title: Kalshi in talks with Sequoia, Wellington for $750 million fund raise at $40 billion valuation
headline_summary: Kalshi targets $750M at $40B from Sequoia, Wellington
blurb: Kalshi is in talks to raise $750 million from Sequoia Capital and Wellington Management at a $40 billion valuation. The event derivatives platform operates prediction markets where traders can bet on real-world outcomes like elections and weather. The funding round signals strong institutional backing for blockchain-based prediction markets, a space that has attracted capital despite regulatory questions around event wagering.

title: Memory maker CXMT overtakes Tencent to become China's most valuable company 17 days after its IPO — now worth $524 billion
headline_summary: Memory chip maker CXMT becomes China's most valuable firm post-IPO
blurb: ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) surpassed Tencent to become China's most valuable company 17 days after its IPO. The memory chip maker reached a $524 billion valuation, indicating strong investor appetite for domestic semiconductor manufacturers. The rapid ascent reflects Beijing's push for chip self-sufficiency and signals substantial capital flowing into strategic technology independence.

title: Legora in talks to raise at a $10bn valuation, according to reports
headline_summary: Legora in talks to raise at $10bn valuation
blurb: Legora is raising capital at a $10bn valuation, marking a significant funding milestone. The company has attracted strong investor interest at this price point, signaling robust market confidence and continued venture capital deployment into high-growth startups. For VCs and LPs, this round demonstrates successful scaling and competitive positioning, representing an important marker in the venture capital landscape and valuation trends.

title: Robinhood Private-Market Fund Prices $200 Million IPO
blurb: Robinhood priced a $200 million IPO for its private-market fund, RVII, expanding retail access to alternatives. The fund structure mirrors traditional GPs: 2% annual base fees and 20% carry on realized gains, with some exposure through illiquid vehicles. This signals retail brokerages now competing directly for LP capital in private markets, a sector historically reserved for institutional allocators and dedicated alternatives firms.

title: Electric joins Databricks to bring WASM Postgres to AI agent sandboxes
headline_summary: Databricks acquires Electric to power AI agent database sandboxes
blurb: Databricks acquired Electric, which builds WebAssembly-based Postgres engines for AI agent sandboxes. The technology safely isolates database workloads in secure virtual machines without traditional performance penalties. As enterprises now deploy autonomous agents into production environments, they need reliable data access locked inside trustworthy security boundaries that can't be compromised. Databricks is betting sandboxed Postgres shifts from optional feature to essential infrastructure.

title: Anthropic Tries to Shore Up Investor Confidence Ahead of Blockbuster IPO
headline_summary: Anthropic Shores Up Investor Confidence Ahead of Blockbuster IPO
blurb: Anthropic is working to build investor confidence ahead of a blockbuster IPO, actively managing relations with its shareholders. The generative AI company's approach to the public markets signals the sector has matured enough for massive exits. For the venture community, this represents a major milestone: the first mega-cap AI IPO and proof that LLM companies can scale to public-market valuations.
